description: React component for the application's footer bar, managing UI elements like account menu, preferences, sync status, updates, and status messages.

classes.name: Footer
classes.description: React component extending AbstractComponent that renders the footer bar, manages application status, updates, sync, and user interactions.

methods.name: reloadUpgradeStatus
methods.description: Checks for security updates and updates component state.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Initializes statuses and user data when the application launches.

methods.name: reloadUser
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the current user.

methods.name: reloadPasscodeStatus
methods.description: Checks if the app has a passcode set.

methods.name: onAppKeyChange
methods.description: Handles logic when app key changes, reloading passcode status.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handles various application events and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: updateSyncStatus
methods.description: Updates UI/status based on sync progress and errors.

methods.name: updateLocalDataStatus
methods.description: Updates status message related to local data loading.

methods.name: updateOfflineStatus
methods.description: Sets offline status based on application state.

methods.name: findErrors
methods.description: Checks and updates error status based on sync errors.

methods.name: securityUpdateClickHandler
methods.description: Handles user action to trigger security update process.

methods.name: accountMenuClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles account menu visibility.

methods.name: quickSettingsClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles quick settings menu.

methods.name: syncResolutionClickHandler
methods.description: Toggles sync resolution menu display.

methods.name: closeAccountMenu
methods.description: Closes the account menu.

methods.name: lockClickHandler
methods.description: Locks the application.

methods.name: onNewUpdateAvailable
methods.description: Handles the event when a new update is available.

methods.name: newUpdateClickHandler
methods.description: Handles user action to dismiss new update banner.

methods.name: betaMessageClickHandler
methods.description: Shows an alert about beta version usage.

methods.name: clickOutsideAccountMenu
methods.description: Closes account menu when clicking outside.

methods.name: clickOutsideQuickSettingsMenu
methods.description: Closes quick settings menu when clicking outside.

methods.name: openPreferences
methods.description: Opens preferences pane, optionally showing 'What's New'.
